History: Born in Tokyo, Japan, Kuriko Yamada moved to the United States in 1980 after marrying Hiroshi Yamada. They settled down in California, where Hiroshi started working as a software engineer for a tech company. Kuriko took care of their home and raised their daughter, Ayumi. Tragically, Hiroshi was killed in a car accident in 2000 while driving home from work. Devastated by her loss, Kuriko decided to honor her late husband's dream of opening a traditional Japanese grocery store in their neighborhood. With the support of her daughter and son-in-law, Kuriko founded Yamada Grocer's in 2001.
